from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the provided collection, capturing its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The exact title of this paper as found in the text")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (from the collection) that this paper explicitly cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
